main.description: Check an account's migration into spaces against its live state, and correct the PDS's record of it. Never updates the DID document and never emits events. PDS-internal and temporary: it exists for the migration into spaces.

storeMigrated.description: Whether the account's store is at the latest schema.

kemKey.description: The public key of the account's KEM keypair, as a did:key, if it holds one.

kemPublished.description: Whether the account's DID document lists its KEM key.

unpublishableReason.description: Why this PDS cannot publish the KEM key, if it cannot.

recordedPublishedAt.description: When the KEM key was recorded published, after any correction.
